development_source_isolation: Development draw excludes chemistry connected to either source-stress panel, before any prediction quality is computed.
reference_policy: Exclude all selected query chemistry components from spectral/reference matching for every compared pipeline; never insert truths into candidate lists.
model_exposure_policy: This is controlled in-corpus validation, not a fresh external identity panel. Public pretrained model exposure is known/unknown and must be reported. New fitted components must exclude their held-out query chemistry. Reference exclusion alone does not erase pretraining exposure.
next_study_reason: C38 primary inventories found no strict unseen timsTOF identities in available cached/current sources. Use controlled source/acquisition tests as development diagnostics, with independent novel-identity confirmation still required before claiming qualification.
C13: Remain sealed. Any eventual use must be predeclared and once-only after candidate/source checks; do not use C13 as target instrument evidence.
